lines.cap: He got hard, after three days in the cold.
lines.say: He got hard, after three days in the cold.

lines.cap: His fingers. Frozen solid on a mountain at minus twenty five.
lines.say: His fingers. Frozen solid on a mountain at minus twenty five.

lines.cap: First they go cold, red and painful. Then numb. That's the warning.
lines.say: First they go cold, red and painful. Then numb. That's the warning.

lines.cap: Below freezing, ice crystals form inside the skin. Blood stops reaching the tips.
lines.say: Below freezing, ice crystals form inside the skin. Blood stops reaching the tips.

lines.cap: The skin turns white or grey, and feels hard, like wax.
lines.say: The skin turns white or grey, and feels hard, like wax.

lines.cap: Don't rub it. Don't warm it by a fire. You can't feel the burn.
lines.say: Don't rub it. Don't warm it by a fire. You can't feel the burn.

lines.cap: Get out of the cold, and warm it in water that's warm, not hot. Then get medical help.
lines.say: Get out of the cold, and warm it in water that's warm, not hot. Then get medical help.

lines.cap: So in the cold, keep your fingers moving, and your gloves on.
lines.say: So in the cold, keep your fingers moving, and your gloves on.
